projects.name: RAG-over-Myself Career Assistant
projects.description: An agentic GraphRAG system that answers questions about my own skills, projects, and courses, and performs job-description gap analysis to suggest resume improvements.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Fraud & Logistics Risk System
projects.description: Designed a 7-agent architecture spanning BigQuery data ingestion, GPU-accelerated feature engineering, graph-based fraud ring detection, and autonomous decision execution. Achieved a 46x speedup in feature engineering using NVIDIA RAPIDS cudf.pandas. Built a graph fraud-ring detector with cuGraph/NetworkX and orchestrated autonomous decisioning with Gemini 2.5 Flash function calling, with a deterministic rule-engine fallback.

projects.name: TruthMate: AI Fake Content Detector
projects.description: Built domain-specific Logistic Regression models using TF-IDF bigrams and oversampling, achieving 99.5% accuracy. Integrated Llama 3.3 via the Groq API as a reasoning layer for contextual red-flag detection and credibility scoring. Deployed via Gradio with automated URL scraping and real-time suspicious-sentence highlighting.

projects.name: Continuum_arena
projects.description: A cyberpunk-styled 2D action arena built with Python and Pygame that features a unique Time Reversal System and procedurally generated maps, allowing players to rewind combat and collect power-ups in fast-paced vector-graphics battles.

projects.name: Mandi Price Prediction & Negotiation App
projects.description: Trained a Random Forest model to predict market prices for agricultural commodities and built a voice-driven negotiation assistant that compares spoken offers to predicted prices. Implemented a multilingual UI (English, Hindi, Kannada) with live confidence scoring and deployed as a Gradio app on Hugging Face Spaces.
